messages:
Tara V: FYI customer asks for per-tenant retention profiles + evidence search SLA. They want 24h for hot, 7d warm, 90d cold retrieval. Can we scope?
Ibrahim H: Two technical paths: keep full-text index for hot/warm vs store encrypted blobs and run retrieval jobs. Cost delta is significant.
Noelle C: For GTM we need crisp SLA table and price model. Suggest tier names: Hot (24h), Warm (7d), Archive (up to 90d retrieval).
Sam O: Ops constraints: hot indexing requires pinned index nodes per tenant for predictable latency. Warm can be rolling index with degraded p99. Archive is async job queue (24-72h).
Tara V: Pilot plan: pick 1-2 enterprise customers, run Warm tier for 6 weeks, measure query cost, p99, and operational load.
Ibrahim H: BYOK caveat: if keys prevent decryption, we can index metadata + hashes only or require private deployment for hot indexing. Need to document options.
Counsel-M: Legal note: SOC2 requires demonstrable access within contractual window; doesn't mandate realtime indexing. Must preserve chain-of-custody and integrity proofs for exports.
Noelle C: UX: admin toggle per tenant to set retention tier + cost preview. Also warn when selecting Hot for BYOK.
Sam O: Implementation risks: index schema drift, cross-region replication for preserved data, and export bundle integrity. Estimate PoC 2 sprints.
Tara V: Acceptance criteria: SLA table published, pilot infra + cost model validated, export bundle spec + manifest, contract language for BYOK.
Ibrahim H: Dev note: hybrid approach looks promising: prefix/KV caching for recent queries + background indexer for warm data to reduce cost spikes.
Tara V: Actions: Ibrahim & Sam to draft PoC infra + estimates (due Wed), Noelle to mock admin UI + pricing (due Tue), Counsel-M to draft SLA/BYOK clauses (due Fri). We'll discuss in roadmap sync Thurs. :thumbsup:
